For R4 & R5 : Mr.A.M.Ravindranath Jeyapal  SC for TNHB  ORDER

This Writ Petition has been filed to issue a Writ of Declaration to declare the acquisition of the land in S.No.373/- of an extent of Ac.0.55 3/4 out of Ac.0.66, in Mogappair village, Ambattur Taluk,
Thiruvallur District
under Award No.12/1983 dated 29.07.1983 stands lapsed.

2. Heard the learned counsel appearing for the petitioner, the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis learned Additional Government Pleader appearing for the official respondents R1 to R3 and learned Standing Counsel for TNHB appearing for R4 and R5.
3.
The petitioner has already filed a writ petition for re-conveyance of the land on the ground that it has been lapsed and the same was disposed of.
Now, the present writ petition has been filed on the same ground that the acquisition proceedings has lapsed.
The petitioner herein is none other than the subsequent purchaser.
The original land owner has not challenged the award.
4. As possession was already taken and the compensation amount was also paid, the subsequent purchaser is not entitled to get the relief sought for in this writ petition.
There is no question of lapse of the acquisition proceedings under the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013.
